description:
Few matchups bring the edge and intensity of the Battle of Pennsylvania, where the Pittsburgh Penguins and Philadelphia Flyers routinely push each other to the limit. Since 1997, the two teams have met six times in the playoffs, with each side winning three series.  One of those showdowns came in the 2009 Stanley Cup Playoffs. In Game 6 of the First Round on the road in Philadelphia, Sergei Gonchar scored his first goal of the postseason early in the third period to break a tie. The goal sealed the series for Pittsburgh, who went on to capture the Stanley Cup later that spring.

description:
In the Battle of Alberta, the Flames and Oilers wasted no time turning the 2022 playoffs into chaos. Game 1 erupted for 15 goals in a wild 9–6 Calgary win. description:
A dominant force on the blueline, Denis Potvin captained the Islanders through their dynasty years, redefining the role of the offensive defenseman on the way to four Stanley Cups and a Hall of Fame career. The first defenseman in NHL history to reach 1,000 points, Potvin set a new benchmark for the position. A three-time Norris Trophy winner with a remarkable +456 rating, he consistently delivered in big moments. In the first sequence, Potvin buries a booming overtime winner in Game 2 of the 1979 playoffs against the New York Rangers. In the second, he strikes again in Game 1 of the 1983 playoffs, scoring the decisive third-period goal—once more against the rival Rangers.

display_meta.name: Rinkside Rivalries
display_meta.description: Rinkside Rivalries is a Core set that dives into hockey at its most intense, spotlighting six of the NHL’s most storied rivalries across some of their most emotional moments. Each rivalry is represented by one goal per team, featuring dramatic overtime tallies, massive momentum shifters, and clutch game-winners that silenced arenas and ignited fanbases—no matter the stage.
